key_expressions: The atmosphere at this expo feels totally different,
The booth layout is pretty confusing,
If you’d like, we can walk around together,
If you have a moment, could we talk briefly,

A: This expo is much bigger than I expected.
Do you have any booths you recommend?
Great, I'll start with that one.
B: Right? It's larger this year because many European companies joined!
Yes, the tech zone in Hall 3 is really interesting.
Sure, I can walk with you and explain a bit.

A: Did you see that presentation? It was really impressive!
If that technology becomes practical, the market could change a lot.
Do you know if we can see a demo today?
B: I did! The presenter explained things so clearly.
Exactly, the automation part was especially innovative.
Yes, there's a live demo at 3 p.m. Want to go together?

A: The booth layout here is a bit confusing. Which way should we go?
Oh, so going right leads to the main hall.
Okay, let’s check that side first and circle back later.
B: Yeah, a lot of people get lost the first time!
Right, that area has most of the main booths.
Sounds good. Let me know if you need help finding anything.

A: Would it be possible to take an extra copy of this brochure?
It’s so well organized—I’d like to share it with my team.
Thanks! I'll use it for our meeting.
B: Of course! I can also send you a PDF if you prefer.
Yeah, it's structured perfectly for team discussions.
Sure, feel free to reach out if you need anything else.

A: It suddenly got crowded. Is some event about to start?
Ah, that explains why people rushed over.
Then should we head there early and grab seats?
B: Yes! The main session begins in ten minutes.
It’s a popular talk, so people usually come early.
Good idea—we might even get front-row seats!

A: This booth design is so stylish. It really stands out.
The consistent concept makes the explanation easier to follow.
Mind if I take a photo?
B: Right? Their design team even won an award this year!
Yeah, the key message comes across clearly.
Sure! Just focus mainly on the product, please.

A: Is the person in charge available right now?
I’d like to ask about system integration directly.
Great, I’ll speak with them once they return.
B: They stepped out briefly but should be back soon.
For integration questions, the specialist is definitely the right person.
I'll let you know as soon as they return.

A: It feels warmer in here than I expected. Want to take a short break?
I see a rest area near the wall.
Nice, we can grab some water and continue afterward.
B: I felt the same! With this many people, it gets warm fast.
Yeah, there are plenty of seats over there.
A quick break will help us recharge!

A: Is it okay if I try this sample product?
Wow, it's lighter than I expected. It feels pretty good!
Alright, then I'd love to hear the feature explanation.
B: Sure, that’s what the sample is for—go ahead!
Right, the new model focuses heavily on reducing weight.
And I can give you a quick demonstration now.

A: I think we’ve covered almost everything. Did we miss any booths?
Oh, we haven’t gone to Hall 5 yet.
Let’s stop by there as our last stop.
B: You’ve seen most of it, but Hall 5’s new product zone is left!
Yeah, there’s a lot worth checking out there.
Perfect—great way to wrap up the day!
